text:
jen: quick sync — we need to lock the customer-facing note and assign owners for remediation follow-ups. proposing a short schedule + visibility rules.

sam: +1. can we split into: 1) status notice copy, 2) 72h interim summary, 3) final technical appendix?

maria: agree with split. also want to call out recurring-pattern detection items as separate owner so we don't lose that in the action list.

alex: for owners, I'd volunteer infra for the detection piece. can we add a single spreadsheet row per action with owner, due date, and verification step? simple format works best.

jen: yep. suggested columns: `action_id | short_desc | owner | due_date | verification | customer_visibility`

louise: legal-bot flagged: "customer_visibility" must be one of: `public_note`, `chaperoned_rca`, `internal_only`. We'll need approvals for any `chaperoned_rca`.

legal-bot: FYI — chaperoned_rca = full RCA available to named customers under NDA or secure link; public_note = redacted summary suitable for status page. Contact security for links.

sam: draft status page snippet (short):
``
We experienced elevated request errors for a subset of customers between 03:12–03:48 UTC. Root cause: degraded KV cache eviction under high burst load. We have deployed mitigations and are continuing monitoring. No customer data was exposed. A detailed technical summary will follow when ready.
``

maria: propose we add one-sentence impact + one-liner mitigation then link to the 72h interim summary where we list action owners. keeps status page concise. :thumbsup:

jen: timeline proposal:
- within 4 hours: post brief status page (public_note) — owner: oncall (sam)
- within 72 hours: interim customer summary with impact metrics and planned remediation (chaperoned_rca option for affected enterprise customers) — owner: postmortem lead (maria)
- within 14 days: final RCA + verification & recurrence mitigation complete — owner: eng lead (alex)

louise: for the 72h interim, recommend including: ETA for final RCA, list of affected regions/customers (redacted for public), and the first 2-3 mitigations in flight.

alex: recording owners:
`INC-2024-08-05-01 | add eviction guardrail | alex | 2024-08-12 | integration test + load run | internal_only`
`INC-2024-08-05-02 | 72h customer interim | maria | 2024-08-08 | review by legal | chaperoned_rca`
`INC-2024-08-05-03 | status page blurb | sam | 2024-08-05 | post done | public_note`

jen: quick checklist for comms:
- status page short blurb (owner: sam)
- send targeted chaperoned summaries to affected enterprise contacts (owner: maria, coordinate w/ sales)
- publish final public postmortem after redaction review (owner: eng + legal)

ops-bot: Deploy note — mitigation v1 applied at 03:55 UTC by @alex. Monitoring: green.

maria: question on distribution: do we need to run targeted emails to affected customers or rely on account managers?

louise: account managers should be contacted for enterprise customers; ops will provide chaperoned link. For anyone asking for full logs, require chaperoned flow + approval.

sam: minor wording suggestion for status page: replace "degraded KV cache eviction" with "cache eviction congestion" — simpler for non-engineers.

jen: +1 simpler wording. updated draft:
``
We experienced increased errors for a subset of customers between 03:12–03:48 UTC due to cache eviction congestion during a sudden traffic burst. Mitigations were deployed; monitoring indicates stability. A 72-hour interim summary with next steps is being prepared for affected customers.
``

alex: can someone own the recurring-pattern ticket? I already put a patch for guarding eviction but we need a detection rule.

maria: assigning to alex (owner of recurrence detection). deadline 2024-08-20.

jen: last items: who signs off the public note? propose: oncall -> postmortem lead -> legal -> product comms.

louise: confirm legal sign-off required for redaction check before public postmortem.

jen: ok noted. I'll create the spreadsheet and ping owners. Action: jen to create tracker and invite owners by EOD.

sam: thanks — I'll post the status page blurb once jen shares the final copy. :rocket:

louise: tagging sales SAs for outreach: @sales-leads please coordinate chaperoned links after maria shares interim.

jen: done. closing thread — feel free to reply here if anything changes.
